metadata.title: fix: allow API tokens to manage tokens
metadata.author: crivetimihai

description:
## Summary
- Renamed `_require_interactive_session` to `_require_authenticated_session` and removed the block on `api_token` auth method, which was preventing API tokens from creating, updating, or revoking tokens
- All existing security layers (RBAC, ownership enforcement, scope containment, admin-only guards) remain intact — the removed guard was redundant
- Added 10 new unit tests covering API token auth across all token endpoints and error message verification

Closes #2870
